GRIP GROVE

Swing, climb and stretch through the forest as a little monkey.

Movement:
VR: Push your hands against the ground and the trees to move, using real GorillaLocomotion physics. Fling your arms to jump. Right stick snap-turns.
Movement: GorillaLocomotion is the only movement. Swing, climb and stretch with your hands.
Shop: Touch the glowing green aura at the Monkey Shop to open the menu, then poke a card (or point and pull the trigger).
Stretchy Arms: A little ball (blue unless you change it) shows where each hand is aiming. Squeeze grip and that arm stretches out, grabs on and pulls you in. Let go to fling.
Screen: WASD / joystick to move, mouse or drag to look, Space to jump. Stretchy arms: left/right mouse (or Q / E, or the blue buttons on phone).
Ball color: Behind the Monkey Shop, poke a color on the Ball Color panel.
